theme.title: We the North
theme.subtitle: Toronto Raptors, 2018–19
theme.recap: Kawhi Leonard arrived, the Raptors survived a Game 7 buzzer-beater and then won Canada's first NBA championship.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season games did the 2018–19 champion Raptors win?
questions.context: Toronto · Kawhi Leonard's lone Raptors season
questions.note: 58 wins, earning second place in the East.

funFacts.text: Toronto exchanged DeMar DeRozan, Jakob Poeltl and a protected pick for Kawhi Leonard and Danny Green.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: DeMar DeRozan (who spent his first nine seasons in the NBA with the Raptors)

funFacts.text: The Raptors added Marc Gasol from Memphis at the trade deadline for a package led by Jonas Valančiūnas.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: Memphis Grizzlies traded Marc Gasol to the Raptors

funFacts.text: Nick Nurse was promoted from assistant coach after Toronto dismissed Dwane Casey.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: the Raptors promoted assistant coach Nick Nurse as their head coach

questions.prompt: How many points per game did Kawhi Leonard score during the Raptors' 2019 playoffs?
questions.context: Toronto · entire 2019 postseason, not just Finals
questions.note: 30.5 per game across Toronto's championship postseason.

funFacts.text: Leonard started every Toronto playoff game and logged 939 minutes during the run.
Toronto rallied from a two-game series deficit by winning four straight against Milwaukee.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: winning the last four games of the series after being down 0–2

funFacts.text: The Raptors became the first team based outside the United States to win the NBA championship.

source.name: Wikipedia contributors (CC BY-SA 4.0)
source.quote: first non-US team to win the NBA title

questions.prompt: What was Kyle Lowry's regular-season assists average for the champion Raptors?
questions.note: 8.7 assists per game from Toronto's lead guard.

funFacts.text: Lowry racked up 564 total assists during the regular season.
He started all 65 games in which he appeared that season.
Lowry handed out ten assists in the road victory that clinched Toronto's first title.

questions.prompt: How many points did Toronto score in Game 7 against Philadelphia in 2019?
questions.note: 92 points, including the shot that advanced Toronto.

funFacts.text: The Raptors needed the full seven games to survive Philadelphia.

questions.prompt: How many regular-season road games did Toronto win on its 2019 title run?
questions.context: Raptors · 41 away games · before the playoffs
questions.note: 26 wins away from home during the regular season.

funFacts.text: Toronto's regular-season home record was stronger than its road record.
Milwaukee finished just ahead of Toronto atop the Eastern Conference standings.
The Raptors won all three Finals games played on Golden State's home floor.
